Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

rtists 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN release.
  • Added plot3d(), an S7 generic with methods for fiber::streamline, fiber::bundle, and fiber::bundle_set objects.
  • Two htmlwidget backends are available through backend (three.js is the default):
    • "threejs": a self-contained three.js renderer (no CDN). thickness > 0 draws real world-space tubes with per-point colour and object-level depth-sorted transparency; the fast line mode scales to large bundles.
    • "plotly": a single scatter3d trace separated by NA break-points, retained as an interim fallback.
  • Colour modes supported by plot3d():
    • "orientation" (default): per-point RGB colour derived from the local fibre direction using the standard DTI convention (left–right = red, anterior–posterior = green, superior–inferior = blue).
    • Metadata key: any key from @point_data or @streamline_data can be mapped to a continuous (palette) or categorical colour scale.
    • Fixed colour: any CSS colour name or hex string.
  • Interactive figures support pan, rotate, and zoom.

Bug fixes

  • The static (non-Shiny) htmlwidgets path is fixed: with the three.js backend, the ESM renderer module is imported asynchronously, which can register its widget binding after htmlwidgets’ initial staticRender() (run once on DOMContentLoaded). The console and Viewer pane therefore produced no canvas and no error. The loader now re-invokes Shiny’s binding scan or HTMLWidgets.staticRender() once the module is ready. The re-render is idempotent, so other widgets are left untouched.
  • Named bundles are honoured correctly in plot3d(): the per-bundle input names recorded by fiber::bundle_set() are now read from the right slot (@bundle_data), so a bundle_set built from a named list keeps its names instead of falling back to sequential indices.
